prompt:
Three separate small scientific illustrations side by side, evenly spaced on a plain pure white background (#ffffff), for a Nature Methods figure. Flat vector style, clean and minimal, consistent thin dark-grey outlines (#2b2f36), soft muted fills, no shading gradients, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no frames.
Left: a small loose group of seven dissociated single cell nuclei (round, slightly varied sizes), soft teal fill (#2a9d8f at low saturation) with a subtle speckled chromatin texture inside each nucleus.
Middle: a thin coronal tissue section of an adult mouse brain seen from above, stained in soft rose-pink and lilac tones like a light H&E stain, with the layered cerebral cortex, the corpus callosum, the hippocampus and the lateral ventricles faintly visible as tonal regions; anatomically plausible outline.
Right: a single large cell nucleus seen from above, very light grey interior with a thin nuclear envelope, containing two chromosome territories drawn as winding chains of small round fluorescent beads joined by thin lines, one chain in orange (#e07a3f) and one in light amber, like a chromatin-tracing microscopy image.
